source_policy.additional_reads: Relevant inference code schemas and sandbox only
source_policy.prior_context_disclosure: This is the same agent with earlier research in conversation history; no earlier candidate, review, prediction or evaluation artifact is read for this study. Fresh decisions use the new uniform protocol and dirty-table evidence.

uniform_contract_policy.denominator: Nonempty values excluding explicitly declared unknown sentinels; unparseable values remain in the denominator. Distinct payload/context support is reported separately. No dataset-specific threshold changes.
uniform_contract_policy.header_unit_rule: An explicit unit in a header can define a unitless numeric scalar contract, even when dirty values redundantly repeat that unit. A coherent numeric-payload rendering supported across distinct dirty peers may define the proposed scalar format. This is a declared format-contract hypothesis, not proof of the underlying value or corruption.
uniform_contract_policy.inferred_unit_rule: When a header specifies a semantic type but not a unit, infer a unit only from strongly coherent explicit unit-bearing dirty evidence and compatible physical semantics. Annotated or contradictory conventions are separate strata.
uniform_contract_policy.canonical_rendering_rule: Require a unique deterministic rendering supported by the column-wide numeric/identifier/language format class or same-value peers. Preserve rare payloads; no mode-to-value replacement, digit reversal, precision recovery, identity merge or numeric range inferred only from frequency.
uniform_contract_policy.numeric_policy: Use exact rational/decimal arithmetic. Do not categorically reject unitless numbers when the unit is already carried by the schema. Opaque identifiers preserve digit strings and leading zeros; scalar counts/ordinals may use a supported canonical integer rendering.
uniform_contract_policy.metadata_policy: Dates, weekdays, timezones, status text, identifier roles, packaging and presentation metadata cannot be silently removed. Joint field movement is proposed only as an atomic bundle preserving all text and roles.
uniform_contract_policy.ambiguity_policy: Competing unit scales, decimal/grouping conventions, lossy rounding, missing digits, uncertain temporal context and unknown identity abstain. A semantically valid input can still fail a declared representation contract; that alone does not make it factually wrong.
uniform_contract_policy.unknown_policy: Blank and explicitly documented unknown tokens preserve unknown meaning. Boolean/categorical constancy never authorizes factual filling.

sampling.group_strategy: Column semantic family, format shape, optional annotations, and cross-column role consistency. Same procedure and thresholds for all six; applicability differs by declared column semantics.

planned_hypotheses.claim: Explicit header units plus coherent numeric payloads support lossless unitless scalar formatting without modal-value truth assumptions.
Compatible explicit unit expressions can be converted exactly into a uniquely supported rendering; ratios and precision must be verified algebraically.
Opaque identifier and language-code formatting can be normalized only with identity/language membership preserved and no lost roles.
Clock/date/status-rich representations need separate strata; only unambiguous pure-clock conversions can be proposed, with no annotation loss.
Cross-column lexical decomposition or composite formatting can support atomic exact conversions while ambiguous dependencies remain advisory or abstained.

output_contract.pass4: <dataset>/pass4.json, schema-compatible and separate from active/frozen pass2/pass3
output_contract.proposals: At most three exact scalar candidates per cell; atomic multi-field bundles remain separate and cannot be flattened into lossy independent repairs. Zero candidates is an explicit abstention. Scores are uncalibrated format-contract confidence, not fitted error probabilities.
output_contract.per_column: Declared semantic type/unit, representation assumptions, competing hypotheses, evidence counts, applicable checkers and abstentions for every column.
output_contract.reporting: Return counts, hashes, paths and limitations only; no illustrative row/value examples. Machine-readable exact proposals necessarily contain the proposed strings.

validation.runtime: Existing sandbox on every dirty row; retain strictly less than 5% syntax/runtime error. Report every generated rule, including rejection.
synthetic: ambiguous percent scale and rounding abstention
legitimate format variants and rare magnitudes
validation.evaluation: No classifier fitting, benchmark evaluation or live promotion. Freeze hashes before independent downstream evaluation.

authorship: One gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh agent performs grouped semantic review. Code counts, samples, executes reviewed conversion templates and validates runtime; no per-cell model/API claim.
